card.name: Lab testing and test-result wording
card.fires_on: Words in lab-testing text where a test or its result is about to be named, such as 'tested' before negative, 'falsely' before elevated, and digits inside analyzer model numbers. It also fires on small words in test-result phrases.

modes.label: Tested negative/positive
modes.description: The word 'tested' or 'initially' in phrases about patients' test results, mostly for TB screening.
modes.example: including the possible development of TB in patients who<< tested>> negative for latent TB infection prior to initiating

modes.label: Analyzer model numbers
modes.description: A digit inside a lab instrument model name or a cut-off measurement.

modes.label: Assay interference wording
modes.description: A qualifier word before an altered test result.
modes.example: resulting in<< falsely>> elevated digoxin plasma concentration results.

card.writes: It suppresses Chinese words for testing, diagnosis and assessment, so it pushes the model away from naming a test or diagnosis next.
card.plain: It marks spots in lab-test text where the next word would be about testing or a test result.
